senses.en: a test of how well something works or how effective it is

senses.label: 預賽、選拔賽

senses.en: a preliminary competition to decide who can take part in a main event

senses.label: 三角形

senses.label: 部落的、部族的

senses.label: 小圈圈的、派系的

senses.label: 致敬、頌揚

senses.en: something said or done to show respect and admiration for someone

senses.en: money or goods paid by a weaker country to a stronger one for protection

senses.en: to teach a student or a small group, especially privately

senses.label: 助教

senses.en: a graduate student who helps a professor teach or guide students at a university

senses.label: 教學影片、教學文章
senses.zh: 在網路上教人做某件事的影片或圖文說明，常見於 YouTube、部落格等。
senses.en: a video, article, or post that teaches you how to do something, especially online

senses.label: （大學的）小班輔導課
senses.zh: 大學裡由助教或老師帶少數學生討論、複習的課程。
senses.en: a small class at a college where a teacher or assistant helps a few students discuss and practice

senses.label: 軟體教學、使用指南
senses.zh: 教人操作某個軟體、網站或工具的一步步說明。
senses.en: a set of instructions that shows you how to use a program, website, or tool

senses.label: 教學用的、輔導的
senses.zh: 形容用來教學或輔導的課程、教材或軟體。
senses.en: used for teaching or helping someone learn a subject or skill

senses.label: 電視、電視機
senses.zh: 家裡用來收看節目、新聞、電影的電器。
senses.en: an electronic device that shows pictures and sound for programs and news

senses.label: 電視（媒體、廣播）
senses.zh: 指電視這個傳播媒體或電視廣播事業，例如「上電視」、「電視節目」。
senses.en: the system or business of sending out programs with pictures and sound

senses.label: 粗花呢、蘇格蘭呢
senses.zh: 一種厚實的粗羊毛布料，表面粗糙、常帶有混色織紋，多用來做外套、西裝。
senses.en: a thick, rough woolen cloth with a mixed-color pattern, often used for coats and suits

senses.label: 花呢衣物、花呢套裝
senses.zh: 用粗花呢做成的衣服，特別是外套或整套西裝，常給人傳統、英式的印象。
senses.en: clothes made of this thick woolen cloth, especially a jacket or a suit

senses.label: 第十二的
senses.zh: 排在第十一之後、第十三之前的位置或順序。
senses.en: coming after the eleventh one and before the thirteenth in a series

senses.label: 十二分之一
senses.zh: 把一個整體平均分成十二份時其中的一份。
senses.en: one of twelve equal parts of a whole

senses.label: 第十二個
senses.zh: 在一連串可數的事物中排第十二的那一個。
senses.en: the thing or person that is number twelve in a series

senses.label: 十二
senses.zh: 數字 12，用於計數、時間（十二點）、年齡、數量等日常情境。
senses.en: the number 12, used for counting, telling time, ages, and amounts

senses.label: 第二十的、第二十個
senses.zh: 排在第十九之後、表示順序第二十的，用於名詞前。
senses.en: coming after the nineteenth one in a series or order

senses.label: 第二十個、第二十位
senses.zh: 指可數序列中的第二十個位置或項目，常寫成 the twentieth。
senses.en: the thing or person that is number 20 in a series

senses.label: 二十分之一
senses.zh: 表示整體分成二十等份中的一份，較少單獨使用。
senses.en: one of 20 equal parts of something

senses.label: 二十
senses.zh: 數字 20，用於計數、年齡、數量等一般情況。
senses.en: the number 20, used for counting or stating an amount

senses.label: 二十的、二十個的
senses.zh: 放在名詞前，表示數量是二十。
senses.en: having the number 20 as an amount

senses.label: 二十美元鈔票
senses.zh: 美國口語指面額二十美元的紙鈔。
senses.en: a banknote worth twenty dollars in the US

senses.label: 兩次、兩回
senses.zh: 表示某件事發生兩次，例如一週兩次、看過兩次。
senses.en: on two occasions or two times

senses.label: 兩倍
senses.zh: 表示數量或程度是原來的兩倍，常與 as 連用（twice as big）。
senses.en: by two times the amount or degree

senses.label: 小枝、細枝
senses.zh: 樹木或灌木上細小的分枝，常指當年或去年長出的末端枝條。
senses.en: a very small thin branch that grows from a larger branch on a tree or bush

senses.label: 明白、領悟
senses.zh: 口語用法，指終於想通或察覺某件事，常說「twig to something」。
senses.en: to finally understand or realize something, especially after not getting it at first

senses.label: 黃昏、暮色
senses.zh: 太陽剛下山、天色還沒全暗的那段時間，也指那時柔和昏暗的光線。
senses.en: the soft, dim light in the sky just after the sun has gone down

senses.label: 暮年、衰退期
senses.zh: 形容某事物在鼎盛之後逐漸走下坡的階段，常用於事業、文化或人生晚期。
senses.en: the later period of something when it is slowly becoming less strong or important

senses.label: 微明的、昏暗的
senses.zh: 形容光線像黃昏一樣柔和不明亮，常見於文學描寫。
senses.en: dim and soft, like the light at the end of the day

senses.label: 雙胞胎之一

senses.en: one of two children born at the same time to the same mother

senses.en: used to describe one of a pair of children born at the same time

senses.label: 成對的、兩個一組的
senses.zh: 指兩個相同或非常相似的事物配成一對，如 twin beds、twin towers。
senses.en: forming a pair of two similar or identical things

senses.label: 極為相似的人或物
senses.zh: 用來指兩個長得非常像或幾乎一模一樣的人或東西。
senses.en: one of two people or things that look almost exactly the same

senses.label: 使結為姊妹市、締結友好關係
senses.zh: 指兩個城市或組織建立正式的合作或友好關係，常見於 twin towns。
senses.en: to establish a formal partnership between two towns or organizations

senses.en: to turn something around or change its shape by turning it

senses.label: 扭傷（關節）

senses.label: 蜿蜒、曲折

senses.label: 轉折、意外發展

senses.en: an unexpected change or development in a story or situation

senses.label: 扭曲、彎曲

senses.en: a bend or turn in something, or the act of turning it

senses.en: a new or clever way of doing something

senses.en: bent or turned out of its normal shape, often by force

senses.label: 被曲解的、遭扭曲的
senses.zh: 形容話語、事實或意思被人故意改變，變得和原意不同。

senses.label: 變態的、扭曲的（心理）

senses.label: 猛然一拉、扯

senses.en: a person of a particular kind, often used informally

senses.en: printed letters or characters, especially in a particular style

senses.label: 典型地、具有代表性

senses.en: in a way that shows the usual qualities of a person or thing

senses.label: 高壓控制、霸道對待
senses.zh: 用威脅、恐嚇或權力逼迫他人服從的情況，不限於國家層級。
senses.en: the use of power or threats to force people to obey, in any situation

senses.label: 輪胎
